konu: Expressing Suggestions and Solutions for Human Rights Problems, Disadvantaged People & Writing an Argumentative Essay (E12.3)
ciktilar: İnsan hakları sorunlarına should, ought to, had better, must, need to ile öneri ve çözüm sunar.
Dezavantajlı bireylerle ilgili kapsayıcı kelimeleri doğru kullanır.
Tartışmacı makaleyi giriş, gelişme, karşıt görüş ve sonuç bölümleriyle bağlaçlarla kurar.
hatirla: Tavsiye: should / ought to + V1; güçlü zorunluluk: must / have to / need to + V1; uyarı içeren acil tavsiye: had better + V1; edilgen öneri: should be + V3.
Kapsayıcı kelimeler: disadvantaged groups, people with disabilities, accessibility, inclusion, equal opportunity, discrimination.
Argumentative essay: introduction (thesis statement) → body paragraphs → counter-argument and refutation → conclusion. Bağlaçlar: Furthermore, However, In conclusion.

sorular.soru: Look at the notice. Which suggestion is the most suitable solution to the problem?
secenekler: The library should build a ramp at the entrance.
Wheelchair users had better stay at home.
The library must close at weekends.
Visitors ought to use the stairs more often.

“Moreover” is a linker that shows contrast.

sorular.soru: Match the expressions with their functions.
Rewrite the sentence using “had better”: “If the factory does not stop child labour, it will face heavy fines.”
sorular.cevap: The factory had better stop child labour, or it will face heavy fines.
